from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

# Create loader
loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load package at v1.0.0 and HEAD
old = loader.load("mypkg", git_ref="v1.0.0")
new = loader.load("mypkg", git_ref="HEAD")

# Get breakages between versions
for breakage in new.get_breakages(old):
    print(breakage)
